So, tactics: I guess I expect France to order Boh - Mun with two supports. We can destroy that army with Ber S Mun, Sil S Mun, and Vie/Gal making a power 2 attack on Boh. Would you rather put your army in Boh or mine? Either is fine with me.

That does mean Vie is tied up, either way. So, we have two options that I see.

1) Tyr is cuttable, but Ser S Tyr - Tri is sufficient to cover it, which means that we can then destroy ADR with Alb S ION - ADR (and then presumably Gre S AEG - ION). This ties up a bunch of units, though, and you might just lose Tyrolia back which wouldn't be so helpful.

In that case, I think we should order Gre S ION, so that we avoid losing ION, and then convoy Con - Nap with Apu support.

3) We try for Venice. Whichever of Apu and Tyr we think is less likely to be cut supports the other to Ven.

4) Apu - Rom, hoping that France ordered TYS S Nap (since if he didn't, the convoy in tends to work). And then I guess a convoy to Apu behind it in case it gets in.

5) Just order Tyr - Pie with the intention of then going to Tus next. Probably pair that one with the attempted convoy to Naples.

Basically, we have a ton of options. They all work some of the time and fail some of the time, and we just get to keep rolling forward and trying again until they succeed. Which do you prefer for this turn?

Tyr to Ven. Apu supports Tyr to Ven

Serbia to Tri. Vienna supports Serb to Tri.

France also claims he will go to Rome. I don't know whether to believe that, either. England also asked me to go to Rome and bounce France.

1) France is going to Rome. If so, I think instead of bouncing him, I should just attack Naples.

2) They're self-bouncing in Rome and want me to go there instead of attacking Naples. In that case, I think I also should just attack Naples.

So, I think I should attack Naples. :)

This also helps with another tactical issue we're having; currently if we destroy ADR, he rebuilds as A Rom. This is inevitable anyway, but that means it would be better for us to destroy it in the spring rather than in a fall turn, so that we have a one-turn window in which he cannot rebuild. &Although if you think France is actually going to Rome this turn, then we can destroy ADR because there would be no rebuild?&

On the other hand, I can appreciate that you might want me out of Galicia as soon as possible, so from that point of view, Vie S Gal - Boh also seems reasonable to me.

Lvn S Nwy - Stp

ION & AEG C Con - Nap
BLA - Con
